id.description: Unique identifier for this provider instance. Used when generating keys to specify which provider to use.

description.description: Human-readable description of this provider instance.
examples: Production HashiCorp Vault for signing keys

vaultUrl.description: URL of the HashiCorp Vault instance. Supports ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.

vaultToken.description: Authentication token for HashiCorp Vault. Supports ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.
